title: Stale time and garbage collection
objective: Separate staleTime freshness from gcTime eviction of unused cache entries, and predict focus/refetch behavior.
predict: A ten-second staleTime may prevent an immediate refetch; after the freshness window, refocus or remount can revalidate. gcTime starts after a query becomes unused.
expectedBehavior: Read immediately twice, refocus at 2 seconds, then refocus after 11 seconds. Explain which reads should reuse cached data and when inactive queries are garbage-collected.
commonFailure: The starter sets infinite freshness and zero cache lifetime, conflating staleness and garbage collection.
securityBoundary: Never assume cache freshness is authorization. A 401/403 must be handled at the server boundary even if a previous cached object existed.
